And Mary who's found an entire network of loving supportive men just needs to find one who's straight.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.312: Pups Save a School Bus
programme.desc: When all the tires on the Adventure Bay school bus blow out, Ryder volunteers to use the Paw Patroller as a substitute school bus.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.113: The Silver Lasso / The Sea Dragon's Treasure
programme.desc: Santiago and Mami team up to take down an old foe and retrieve a lost family treasure. // After Enrique nabs a Sea Dragon's golden egg, it's up to the good pirates to nab it back before things get out of control.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.324: Fun Fair
programme.desc: The family go to the funfair, but Mummy Pig is angry when people at the fair tell her that she will not be able to win prizes in the competitions, just like George is sad because the mini golf course is too big for him.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.325: Numbers
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's daycare.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.326: Digging Up the Road
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S4 Ep.401: Freddy Fox
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.203: Summer Camp I / Summer Camp II
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island. // The Barbababies, the twins, and Mr. Strict set sail on "Thésée", a magnificent sailboat.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.126: The Seven Foods
programme.desc: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.922: Pups Save the Wind Trekkers / Pups Save a Trophy
programme.desc: When Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta get trapped inside a mesa, it's up to the Paw Patrol and a little snake to rescue them. // When Humdinger's mom Helga loses her son's phony trophy, the Paw Patrol have to rescue her and the trophy.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 Ep.1004: Pups Save a Drive-in
programme.desc: The Pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector at the new drive-in.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.206: The Crew Builds A Gym / The Crew Puts On A Construction Show
programme.desc: Coach Karima asks Rubble & Crew to build a gym for the gymnastics show. But when the beam is too high for Lily, it's up to the pups to save the day.//When a traveling show can't get to Builder Cove, Rubble & Crew decides to build a show of their own!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.207: The Crew Builds Charger A Super Bed / The Crew Builds A Super Squirrely Whirly Playground
programme.desc: Charger has a problem... he's got too much energy to sleep! Lucky for him, Rubble & Crew knows there's always a construction solution. // Rubble and the pups build Mix, Motor, Lucas, and Lily the coolest Super Squirrely Whirly playdate ever!

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.510: Selena's Big Bike Race / Follow That Flute
programme.desc: Dora and Boots team up with their friend Selena the Snake to win the Tricky Trappy Bike Race! // On the day of the Pet Talent Show, Dora and Boots race to save Perrito, Lucky and other pets who run off following a magical flute.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.511: Super Perrito / Benny and the Pets
programme.desc: When Perrito puts on a cape that gives him superpowers, Dora, Boots, and "Super Perrito" zoom around the rainforest saving friends in need! // Dora and Boots help their friend Benny find his perfect pet among all the adorable pets at Pick-a-Pet Park.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.114: The Treasure Hunt / Going into the Wild
programme.desc: Mr. Strict's twins visit the barbababies. The barbababies organize a treasure hunt for the twins and enjoy the great outdoors. // The Barbapapas are off to a new adventure... in the garden. But living in nature is more complicated than they expected.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.115: The Fuchsia Ocean / Zero Waste
programme.desc: Chemical sprays are making the countryside rosy! The Barbapapas' build an aviary to protect sick birds. // When they see a beach covered with rubbish, the Barbapapa family decides to clean the beach and use the trash to make a miniature golf course.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.116: Hiccupism / Silence please
programme.desc: Barbabeau can't paint. He has a hiccup he can't get rid of. Just when he's about to give up, he accidentally creates a new artistic movement. // Barbalib wants to compete in a writing contest but his brothers and sisters stop her from concentrating.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.117: Where Did It Go Barbabravo? / The Big Bad Hen
programme.desc: Like a secret agent, Barbabravo leads the investigation equipped with his gadgets to find out who stole Barbapapa's cake. // Barbalala is convinced she heard a giant hen prowling around the house. The Barbababies organize themselves to stand guard.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.118: Clock and Dance / Barbapileup
programme.desc: The barbababies prepare a show for Barbamama's birthday. While Barbalala finishes up, they go to the carnival where Barbabeau gets stuck in an attraction. // Three separate stories telescope into a big final bouquet in the middle of the courtyard.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.223: The Crew Builds A Kangaroo Safari / The Crew Plays In The Construction Games
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the Bark Yard... until their construction kangaroo hops away! // Speed Meister challenges Rubble & Crew to compete in the ultimate build-off: Builder Cove's first Construction Games!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.224: The Crew And Rocky Build A Bear Island
programme.desc: Rocky visits Rubble & Crew from Adventure Bay just in time to see Builder Cove's new baby bear! But when Park Ranger Rose asks for construction help, Speed Meister accidentally ruins the bears' home. It's up to all the pups and Rocky to save the day!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.925: Pups Save the Baby Space Rocks / Pups Save the Eddies and Emmys
programme.desc: When a mysterious storm drops hailstones that hatch into Baby Space Rocks, the Pups must find a way to keep them safe. // A 3-D printer leads to trouble when Eddie and Emmy make 3-D reproductions of themselves and play pranks all over Adventure Bay.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.926: Charger Visits the Pups / Pups Save a Shiny Ride
programme.desc: Rubble's cousin, Charger, visits Adventure Bay just in time to help out when a Humdinger-caused geyser destroys Mr. Porter's cafe. // Mayor Humdinger hatches a plan to sabotage a "Shinest Ride Contest", so it's up to the Paw Patrol to save the day.

programme.title: Deer Squad S3 Ep.307: Deep Dive / Firefruit Surprise
programme.desc: When Lola and Jade think they see mermaids in Sparkle Sea, Jade uses a Glow Crystal trying find them and disturbs the deep-sea fishes below. // Steel convinces Bobbi to harvest a fire-fruit on Sparkle Island but they set off a volcano unexpectedly!

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S1 Ep.104: Big News with Blue
programme.desc: Blue has something exciting to tell everybody! In this game of Blue's Clues, Josh and the viewer go on a note finding quest, solving riddles, and following treasure maps to find out the answer to Blue's Big News.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.110: Surf / Spaceship / Pizza
programme.desc: Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick. // Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship. // Tim tries to rid the house of a troublesome space bug.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.216: The Crew Builds A Bowling Alley / The Crew Builds A Superbloom Path
programme.desc: Rubble & the pups find Grandpa Gravel's lucky bowling ball. Too bad Builder Cove doesn't have a bowling alley... until now! // When a sudden superbloom traps Motor, Lily, and Park Ranger Rose, the pups need a flower-friendly construction solution.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.109: Santiago's Greatest Treasure / The Golden Banana Treasure
programme.desc: When Bonnie Bones steals a chest of pirate treasures, Santiago learns just how much he needs his crew. // Santi and crew navigate the tricky Banana Island to save a baby monkey and its treasure from Enrique.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.513: Grandpa Boots / Super Stretchy Sloth
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Grandpa Boots find his missing boots so they can have the Best Bootsy Day ever!/When Simón the Alebrije Sloth gets stretchy powers instead of super speed, Dora and Boots help him track down a magic leaf that can switch his powers.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S1 Ep.104: Big News with Blue
